streamsConfig.audioSettingsHelp: Audio recording applies to both continuous and detection-based recordings (requires audio track in stream). Voice Enhancement is a preview opt-in that has no effect yet — the noise-reduction filter chain for the G.711 → AAC transcode lands in a future update; recordings only, live audio is unchanged.
streamsConfig.detectionUrlHelp: Secondary stream used only for object detection. Must be an http, https, rtsp, or rtsps URL (e.g. RTSP or HTTP MJPEG). MJPEG is strongly recommended: every frame is a self-contained JPEG so unused frames are skipped with minimal overhead. For H.264/H.265 streams every frame must be decoded to keep the reference chain intact — detection still runs at the configured interval, but CPU usage is significantly higher. Leave empty to run detection on the main stream.

streamsConfig.publishUrlHelp: Restream this camera to a service like YouTube Live via go2rtc. Paste the full RTMP ingest URL including the stream key (e.g. rtmp://a.rtmp.youtube.com/live2/xxxx-xxxx). YouTube requires H264 video and AAC audio; LightNVR now transcodes automatically (H264 for non-H264 cameras, AAC for non-AAC audio) so most cameras work as-is. Note: YouTube also requires an audio track — a camera with no audio at all will still be rejected. Leave blank to disable.

Useful for dual-lens cameras where one lens provides motion events (e.g., fixed wide) and the other does not (e.g., PTZ). Leave empty to use this stream's own motion events.
streamsConfig.go2rtcSourceOverrideHelp: Advanced: Override the go2rtc source URL(s) for this stream — a single URL or a multi-source YAML list for failover/transcoding. When set, credentials and transport parameters are NOT auto-injected. For account-level module config (e.g. wyze:, homekit: credentials), use Settings → go2rtc Config Override instead. Leave empty for automatic configuration. Changing this will restart go2rtc.

settings.storageTargets.editorHelp: Enabled targets must already exist and pass a write, fsync, and cleanup test. Save an unavailable future mount as disabled, then enable it after mounting.
settings.storageTargets.name: Target name
settings.storageTargets.rootLocked: A default or nonempty target keeps an immutable root so existing footage cannot be orphaned.
settings.storageTargets.migrationBandwid: 0 is unlimited. The limit is snapshotted when a move or copy job is created.
settings.storageTargets.archiveWindowHel: Local time. Equal start and end times allow lifecycle jobs all day; an overnight window may cross midnight.
settings.storageTargets.mountRequiredHel: Pin this target to its current non-root mountpoint. If that NFS, SMB, bind, or PVC mount disappears, recording pauses instead of writing into the underlying host directory.
settings.storageTargets.mountPending: Will be detected when the target is enabled
settings.storageTargets.cleanupActive: Target-scoped cleanup is active and will work toward {target} available without deleting recordings assigned to another target.
settings.storageTargets.duplicateFilesys: This root shares the same underlying filesystem as another target. Capacity must not be counted twice when placement is enabled.
settings.storageTargets.deleteLocked: Default and nonempty targets cannot be deleted.
settings.storageTargets.deleteConfirm: Delete the empty storage target “{name}”? No files will be removed.
settings.storageTargets.invalidThreshold: Check watermarks, reserve, lifecycle bandwidth, and archive-window times.
settings.storagePools.title: Storage pools
settings.storagePools.description: Group healthy targets for automatic spillover and distinct-target replication.
settings.storageMigrations.title: Recording migration jobs
settings.storageMigrations.description: Durable moves and retained copies honor each target's archival window and bandwidth limit, verify SHA-256, and recover safely after restart.
settings.storageMigrations.loadError: Could not load recording migration jobs
settings.storagePolicies.title: Camera placement policies
settings.storagePolicies.description: Route matching cameras to a primary recording target in priority order. A camera uses the first enabled policy that matches.
settings.storagePolicies.editorHelp: The policy is re-evaluated for new segments. Changes do not move recordings that already exist.
settings.storagePolicies.previewRequired: Preview the current draft before saving to see camera overlap and the effective winning policy.
settings.storagePolicies.previewSummary: Matches {matched} cameras; this draft is effective for {effective}.
settings.storagePolicies.previewShadowed: A higher-precedence policy wins for {count} matching cameras.
settings.storagePolicies.previewNoMatche: This selector currently matches no cameras.
settings.storagePolicies.invalidPriority: Priority must be a whole number between -1,000,000 and 1,000,000.
settings.storagePolicies.invalidLifecycl: Check retention ordering, copy count and replication pool, and migration age and target.
settings.storagePolicies.deleteConfirm: Delete placement policy “{name}”? Existing recordings are not affected.
settings.storagePolicies.empty: No placement policies. Cameras continue using the default target.
settings.storageCompliance.title: Capacity and policy compliance
settings.storageCompliance.description: Observed 30-day rates forecast target pressure and achieved retention; active lifecycle violations remain visible until resolved.
settings.hlsStoragePathHelp: Optional path for HLS segments. If not specified, storage path will be used.
settings.recordingDirectoryFormatHelp: Partitions new MP4 recordings beneath each camera folder. Existing recordings are not moved.
settings.minFreePctHelp: Keep at least this percentage of the volume free by automatically evicting the oldest recordings, regardless of retention days. This bounds usage to the disk size — set it and the disk never fills. 0 disables the capacity cap.
settings.pressureThresholdsHelp: Free-space bands that escalate automatic cleanup. Must satisfy emergency < critical < warning.
settings.enableGridViewThumbnailsHelp: Allow grid view with thumbnail previews on recordings page
settings.thumbnailsPerRecordingHelp: Slow CPUs should use 1: skips the seek needed for middle/end frames
settings.databaseBackupIntervalHelp: How often to flush, verify, and back up the SQLite database while the system is running. Set to 0 to keep startup/shutdown backups only.
settings.databaseBackupRetentionHelpBefo: How many timestamped backups to keep. Set to 0 to retain only the latest
settings.postBackupScriptHelp: Optional absolute path to an executable that runs after a verified backup. It receives: backup path, database path, and backup directory.
settings.threadPoolHelp: Number of libuv worker threads. Default is 2× the number of CPU cores (clamped 2–128).
settings.maxStreamsHelpBefore: Stream engine capacity — how many cameras can run simultaneously. Changing this requires a
settings.maxStreamsHelpAfter: Use the Streams page to add cameras up to this limit.
settings.demoModeHelp: Allow unauthenticated users to view streams (viewer access only)
settings.disableWebrtcHelp: When enabled, all streams will use HLS instead of WebRTC
settings.enabledViewMethodsHelp: Pick which live-view selectors appear on the dashboard. Auto is optional; at least one playback transport must stay enabled.
settings.viewMethodMse: MSE — low latency via go2rtc, consistent playback
settings.sessionIdleTimeoutHelp: How long a signed-in session may sit inactive before re-authentication is required.
settings.absoluteSessionLifetimeHelp: Hard cap for a session even if the user stays active. Should be greater than or equal to the idle timeout.
settings.rememberDeviceDaysHelp: How long a successfully MFA-verified device can skip the next TOTP prompt. Set to 0 to disable remembered devices.
settings.trustedProxyCidrsHelpAfter: when the immediate peer IP matches one of these CIDRs. Leave blank to ignore forwarded headers.
settings.setupWizardHelp: Resets the first-run wizard so it appears again on the dashboard.
settings.forceMfaOnLoginHelp: Require TOTP on untrusted devices. Users can still mark a device as trusted after a successful MFA verification.
settings.loginRateLimitingHelp: Limit login attempts to prevent brute force attacks
settings.maxLoginAttemptsHelp: Maximum failed login attempts before lockout (minimum 1)
settings.rateLimitWindowSecondsHelp: Time window in seconds for rate limiting (minimum 10 seconds, default 300 = 5 minutes)
settings.detectionBasedRecordingDescript: Configure detection-based recording for streams. When enabled, recordings will only be saved when objects are detected.
settings.motionDetectionDescription: Built-in motion detection is available without requiring any external models. Select "motion" as the detection model in stream settings to use this feature. You can configure the detection model for each stream in the Stream Settings page.
settings.optimizedMotionDetectionDescrip: A memory- and CPU-optimized variant of motion detection designed for embedded and low-power devices. When "motion" is selected as the detection model, this optimized implementation is used automatically on supported devices; no additional configuration is required.
settings.detectionModelsPathHelp: Directory where detection models are stored
settings.apiDetectionUrlHelp: URL of the external object detection API endpoint
settings.apiDetectionBackendHelp: Inference backend used by the detection API
settings.detectionEngineEnabledHelp: Run TFLite/LiteRT inference inside LightNVR. Streams whose model_path is a .tflite file will use this engine.
settings.detectionGracePeriodHelp: Seconds after the last detection before recording transitions to post-buffer. Increase if detections have brief gaps that should be treated as continuous motion (0–60, default: 2).
settings.defaultPreDetectionBufferHelp: Seconds of video to keep before detection
settings.defaultPostDetectionBufferHelp: Seconds of video to keep after detection
settings.defaultBufferStrategyHelp: How pre-detection video is buffered. "Auto" selects the best strategy based on your setup.
settings.defaultPlaybackTransportHelp: Playback profile applied to newly-created streams. Existing streams keep their own selection.
settings.go2rtcIntegrationDescription: go2rtc provides WebRTC and HLS streaming. Changes require a restart to take effect.
settings.enableGo2rtcHelp: When disabled, go2rtc will not be started and HLS will connect directly to camera streams. This saves bandwidth for WiFi cameras but disables WebRTC live view.
settings.forceNativeHlsHelp: Use lightNVR's native FFmpeg-based HLS instead of go2rtc HLS for live view. Useful if go2rtc HLS has compatibility issues. WebRTC is not affected.
settings.enableStunHelp: Enable STUN for NAT traversal (needed for remote WebRTC)
settings.stunServerHelp: STUN server address for NAT traversal
settings.externalIpHelp: Optional: External IP for NAT (leave empty for auto-detect)
settings.go2rtcConfigOverrideHelp: Advanced: Append custom YAML sections to go2rtc.yaml. Duplicate top-level keys override auto-generated ones (last-key-wins). Use for source-module credentials (wyze:, homekit:, hass:, roborock:), custom ffmpeg presets, publish destinations, log levels, etc. Changing this will restart go2rtc.
settings.mqttEventStreamingDescription: Publish detection events to an MQTT broker for integration with Home Assistant or other systems.
settings.enableMqttHelp: Stream detection events to MQTT broker
settings.brokerHostHelp: MQTT broker hostname or IP address
settings.retainMessagesHelp: Broker stores last message for new subscribers
settings.homeAssistantAutoDiscoveryDescr: Automatically register cameras and sensors in Home Assistant via MQTT discovery. Requires the same MQTT broker used by Home Assistant.
settings.enableHaDiscoveryHelp: Cameras and motion sensors appear automatically in Home Assistant
settings.discoveryPrefixHelp: Must match Home Assistant's MQTT discovery prefix (default: homeassistant)
settings.snapshotIntervalSecondsHelp: How often to publish camera snapshots (0 = disabled, max 300)
settings.webrtcTurnServerDescription: Configure a TURN relay server for WebRTC when direct peer-to-peer connections fail (e.g., behind restrictive NAT/firewall).
settings.enableTurnRelayHelp: Use TURN server for WebRTC relay when direct connection fails
settings.onvifDiscoveryDescription: Configure ONVIF camera discovery settings. Use CIDR notation (e.g., 192.168.1.0/24) or "auto" for automatic network detection.
settings.enableOnvifDiscoveryHelp: Automatically discover ONVIF cameras on the network
settings.discoveryIntervalSecondsRangeHe: How often to scan for cameras (30–3600 seconds)
investigation.title: Investigation
investigation.description: Review several cameras against one shared UTC cursor without hiding gaps in footage.
investigation.queryHelp: Choose up to 16 cameras. At most four video players are active at once.
investigation.confidenceError: Minimum confidence must be between 0 and 1.
investigation.regionSearchHelp: Choose a primary camera with footage, then draw an area over its video.
investigation.regionActive: Searching stored boxes from {camera}. A missing result is not proof that nothing crossed the area.
investigation.drawRegionPrompt: Drag over the video to define the search area
investigation.searchHelp: Load an investigation to search its persisted event metadata.
investigation.histogramHelp: Select a bar to move the shared cursor.
investigation.noResults: No persisted events match this camera, time, and filter selection.
investigation.thumbnailDrilldownHelp: Choose any moment, including a gap, to move the shared cursor and regenerate a narrower set of samples.
investigation.thumbnailCoverageTruncated: This interval contains more recordings than the sampler could inspect. Narrow the time window for complete coverage.
investigation.bookmarks.notHold: A bookmark restores this view, but it does not protect recordings from normal retention or deletion.
investigation.bookmarks.title: Bookmark name
investigation.bookmarks.empty: You have no saved investigation bookmarks.
investigation.actions.title: Investigation recordings
investigation.actions.notEvidenceExport: Protection prevents normal retention deletion. The ZIP download is a convenience export, not a verified evidence package.
investigation.actions.fullWindow: All cameras in the investigation window
investigation.actions.invalidRange: Choose a valid time range with the end after the start.
investigation.actions.noRecordings: No completed recordings overlap this camera and time selection.
investigation.actions.protectDenied: {count} unprotected recording(s) are outside your protection scope and are excluded from this action.
investigation.actions.exportDenied: Export permission is missing for {count} recording(s). Downloads are all-or-nothing, so this selection cannot be exported.
investigation.actions.protectUnavailable: There are no unprotected recordings you are permitted to protect.
investigation.actions.downloadUnavailabl: Every recording requires export permission before a ZIP can be created.
investigation.actions.downloadFailed: ZIP creation failed on the server.
investigation.actions.downloadTimedOut: ZIP creation did not finish within five minutes. Try a narrower interval.
investigation.thumbnailMinimumWindow: This is the narrowest available one-second interval. The shared cursor still moved to the selected moment.
investigation.incompleteCoverage: {count} legacy event rows could not be attributed to an immutable camera identity.
investigation.spatialCoverageGap: {count} in-scope event rows had no bounding box and were not searched spatially.
investigation.noSpatialMetadata: No in-scope events have bounding boxes for this metadata search.
investigation.missingCameraIdentity: Cannot investigate: {count} selected recording(s) have no camera identity.
investigation.recordingTimeError: The selected recordings do not have a valid time range.
investigation.windowLimit: The selected recordings span more than the 31-day investigation limit.
investigation.timeRangeError: The end time must be after the start time.
investigation.cameraLimit: An investigation can include at most {count} cameras.
investigation.decoderLimit: Only {count} camera players can be active at once.
investigation.activateCamera: Activate at least one timeline row to load video.
investigation.noFootageAtTime: No footage at the shared time
streamsConfig.eptzHelp: Dewarp the untouched fisheye stream in Live View and Timeline playback. This does not alter recordings or camera output.
streamsConfig.eptzModelHelp: Projection: equidistant circular fisheye · Mount: ceiling. Center and radius use normalized source-image coordinates.
streamsConfig.eptzCalibrationHelp: Drag to look around, use the wheel or pinch to zoom, and press Home to reset the virtual camera. Fine-tune center and radius if the image-circle edge does not align.
